items.source: The DispatcherServlet will use the context to discover Spring MVC infrastructure and application controllers in it. The context must have been configured with a ServletContext.
items.translation: `DispatcherServlet` 将使用上下文来发现其中的 Spring MVC 基础设施和应用控制器。该上下文必须已配置了 `ServletContext`。

items.source: When this builder is used, the minimum infrastructure required by the DispatcherServlet to serve requests with annotated controllers is created automatically and can be customized, resulting in configuration that is equivalent to what MVC Java configuration provides except using builder-style methods.
items.translation: 当使用此构建器时，会自动创建 `DispatcherServlet` 服务带有注解的控制器所需请求所需的最低基础设施，并且可以进行自定义，从而生成与 MVC Java 配置提供的配置等效的结果，只是使用构建器风格的方法。

items.source: When this builder is used, the minimum infrastructure required by the DispatcherServlet to serve requests with router functions is created automatically and can be customized, resulting in configuration that is equivalent to what MVC Java configuration provides except using builder-style methods.
items.translation: 当使用此构建器时，会自动创建 `DispatcherServlet` 所需的最小基础设施，以提供具有路由功能的请求服务，并且可以进行自定义，从而生成与 MVC Java 配置等效的配置，只是使用构建器风格的方法。

items.source:
If the Spring MVC configuration of an application is relatively
straight-forward — for example, when using the MVC namespace in
XML or MVC Java config — then using this builder might be a good
option for testing a majority of controllers. In such cases, a much
smaller number of tests can be used to focus on testing and verifying
the actual Spring MVC configuration.
items.translation: 如果应用程序的 Spring MVC 配置相对简单——例如在 XML 中使用 MVC 命名空间或在 Java 配置中使用 MVC——那么使用此构建器可能是测试大多数控制器的一个不错的选择。在这种情况下，可以使用更少数量的测试用例来专注于测试和验证实际的 Spring MVC 配置。

items.source:
This allows full control over the instantiation and initialization of
router functions and their dependencies, similar to plain unit tests while
also making it possible to test one router function at a time.
items.translation: 这允许对路由函数及其依赖项的实例化和初始化进行完全控制，类似于普通的单元测试，同时也使得逐个测试每个路由函数成为可能。

items.source: Build a MockMvc instance using the given, fully initialized (i.e., refreshed) WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 使用给定的、完全初始化（即刷新）的WebApplicationContext构建一个MockMvc实例。

items.source: Build a MockMvc instance by registering one or more RouterFunction instances and configuring Spring MVC infrastructure programmatically.
items.translation: 通过注册一个或多个 RouterFunction 实例并编程方式配置 Spring MVC 基础设施来构建 MockMvc 实例。

items.source: Build a MockMvc instance by registering one or more @Controller instances and configuring Spring MVC infrastructure programmatically.
items.translation: 通过注册一个或多个 `@Controller` 实例并编程方式配置 Spring MVC 基础设施来构建一个 `MockMvc` 实例。

items.source: controllers - one or more @Controller instances to test (specified Class will be turned into instance)
items.translation: controllers - 一个或多个要测试的 @Controller 实例（指定的 Class 将被转换为实例）

items.source: routerFunctions - one or more RouterFunction instances to test
items.translation: routerFunctions - 一个或多个要测试的 RouterFunction 实例

items.source:
Consider adding this class as a Java editor favorite. To navigate to
this setting, open the Preferences and type "favorites".
items.translation: 考虑将此类添加为 Java 编辑器收藏夹。要导航到该设置，请打开首选项并输入"favorites"。

items.source:
This allows full control over the instantiation and initialization of
controllers and their dependencies, similar to plain unit tests while
also making it possible to test one controller at a time.
items.translation: 这允许对控制器及其依赖项的实例化和初始化进行完全控制，类似于普通的单元测试，同时也使得逐个测试每个控制器成为可能。
